hostname edge-fw
!
object network WEB-01
 host 10.20.4.15
 description Sanitized HTTPS application endpoint
!
object network CLIENT-NET
 subnet 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0
!
object-group network APPROVED-CLIENTS
 network-object object CLIENT-NET
!
access-list OUTSIDE-IN extended permit tcp object-group APPROVED-CLIENTS object WEB-01 eq https log
access-list OUTSIDE-IN extended deny tcp any object WEB-01 eq ssh log
access-list OUTSIDE-IN extended permit tcp any object UNRESOLVED-APP eq 8443
access-group OUTSIDE-IN in interface outside
!
username sanitized-user password 5 PASSWORD_CANARY_VALUE
snmp-server community COMMUNITY_CANARY_VALUE
tunnel-group sanitized-vpn ipsec-attributes
 ikev1 pre-shared-key TUNNEL_KEY_CANARY_VALUE
